notes: Apps on the VPN can now use the microphone and camera. macOS was blaming VPNonly for those requests and killing the app on the spot — WhatsApp crashed the instant a call started, and Chrome on a video call would have too. VPNonly now launches apps so they answer for their own privacy prompts, the way Terminal does. Also: automatic reconnection after a network change, with a few attempts over a couple of minutes instead of one; quitting with the VPN down and apps still held offline now asks whether to put them back first; a plain log at ~/Library/Logs/VPNonly.
